keyboard.behavior: Follow ancestor links; the non-link current item and decorative dividers are not keyboard controls.
Navigate through a focused ancestor link.

guidelines: Use a named navigation landmark and an ordered list for hierarchy.
Add explicit breadcrumb-divider elements and authored aria-hidden; do not assume CSS hides content from assistive technology.
Use breadcrumb-link on each destination/current surface and mark exactly one current item.
Separators can be empty for the CSS mask or contain text/SVG; there is no breadcrumb-divider string token.
These examples deliberately compose fg-body for readable ancestor text. Test colors when customizing tokens.
Localize directional glyphs deliberately; logical spacing is not automatic icon mirroring.

keyboard.behavior: Follow native controls in DOM order; static items are not tab stops.
Activate native buttons; links retain Enter navigation and inputs retain native selection behavior.

guidelines: Choose native list, navigation or control semantics based on the actual content.
CSS active state is visual; application selection and dynamic panels are separate concerns. Use the Tab plugin for dynamic list-backed tab panes.
Use native disabled on buttons and deliberately remove/guard unavailable link destinations.
Responsive horizontal variants use container queries and require a query container; avoid combining horizontal and flush layouts.
Use real theme classes and text status labels. Copy the disclosed demo contrast CSS for the customized active/contextual examples.
Native checkboxes/radios require accessible labels and do not become a custom listbox widget.

guidelines: Give each result navigation a meaningful label and mark exactly one current page.
Use page-item wrappers for seam and radius rules and page-link for the actual surface.
Remove or guard disabled destinations; aria-disabled and tabindex alone do not prevent all activation.
Provide names for icon-only links and hide decorative glyphs from assistive technology.
Example query URLs demonstrate destinations only; your application must provide result data and render the corresponding current state.
Use the actual size and padding/radius tokens; the pinned source has no pagination-gap token. Test custom colors and copy the disclosed demo contrast CSS when using customized examples.
